notes: Primary research article (Carbon 173, 2021), not retracted (record is_retracted false; no retraction notice in PDF). Three carbon sorbents (TE7 activated carbon, TiC-CDC-800, SWCNTs) with 77 K excess H2 isotherms to ~13-16.5 MPa (Fig. 9; SI Figs. S5-S7). The paper refers to previous work [22] only for TE7 INS details ('Detailed information for TE7 can be found in our previous work [22]'); it does not state that its H2 uptake values were published before, so duplicate_data does not apply. SI Table S1 'Max uptake (wt%)' values are Toth-model theoretical maxima, not measured points.
